title: Algorithm Operations Return Result With Warnings And Infos
description: Introduce OperationResult for compose algorithms; migrate flattenDesign, delete/copy paths, callers; clump fixed-piece warnings.
summary: Introduced OperationResult (ok, change, warnings, infos | errors) in @semio-tech/compose-js: flattenDesign, deletePiecesAndConnectionsInDesign, removePiecesAndConnectionsFromDesign, copyDesign, piecesMetadata. Flatten emits flatten.no-fixed-piece-in-clump warning, connection skips as warnings, placement failures as errors; summary info. Normalizers for native REST. Updated nativeAlgorithmAdapter, UI MCP flatten, algorithm and UI Storybook stories. Extended vitest with floating-clump warning case. All 158 js tests pass.
